verdict.rationale: Weaviate documents official client libraries in Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Go, and Java. Its quickstart shows programmatic collection creation, data import and querying, and the GitHub README describes a single query interface, so the product can clearly be driven programmatically. A community comment also confirms a GraphQL interface exists. missing for 10: an explicit public REST/GraphQL API reference in the evidence, documentation of API authentication, and hands-on corroboration of driving the API end-to-end.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Follow the instructions below to install one of the official client libraries, available in Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Go, and Java.
Set up a collection - Create a collection and import data into it.
It combines vector similarity search with keyword filtering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and reranking in a single query interface.
